snmp_enabled.description: Enable SNMP support in CUPS (required for SNMP-based printer monitoring and discovery)

snmp_community.description: SNMP community string for read-only access — should be changed from default in production

snmp_trap_destinations.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses to which SNMP traps (e.g., printer alerts) will be sent

items.description: IP address or hostname of SNMP trap receiver

snmp_contact.description: SNMP system contact — typically an email or phone number for the print system administrator

snmp_location.description: SNMP system location — physical or logical location of the print server

snmp_printers.description: Which printers SNMP monitoring should apply to: 'none', 'all', or a space-separated list of printer names

snmp_timeout.description: SNMP query timeout in seconds — how long to wait for a response before retrying

snmp_retries.description: Number of times to retry an SNMP query before giving up

snmpv3_enabled.description: Enable SNMPv3 support (requires additional configuration in cupsd.conf — CUPS itself does not parse SNMPv3 settings here)
